instruction.name: xvreplve.h
instruction.description: Replicate a h element of xj using a GPR index.

latencies.notes: Latency from the vector source xj to the destination: 1 cycle, the shortest path in the vector unit. The chain replicates element 0 and feeds the result back into the source through one xvadd.b (1 cycle, subtracted); chaining two replicas reads 1.97 cycles, i.e. 1 cycle each.

Latency from the rj index register to the destination: 3 cycles, two more than the vector-source path because the GPR value has to select the lane before the data can be moved. Measured through xvpickve2gr.d (3 cycles subtracted, 5 for the double-width pick); a chain that also reads the destination measures the same 7.97 cycles, so the source self-dependency is renamed away and does not hide the index path.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvreplve.h $xr0, $xr8, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr1, $xr9, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr2, $xr10, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr3, $xr11, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr4, $xr12, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr5, $xr13, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr6, $xr14, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr7, $xr15, $r5
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvreplve.h $xr0, $xr8, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr1, $xr9, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr2, $xr10, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr3, $xr11, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr4, $xr12, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr5, $xr13, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr6, $xr14, $r5; xvreplve.h $xr7, $xr15, $r5'

notes: Latency measured from each source operand: 1 cycle from the vector source and 3 cycles from the index register. Both are register-to-register paths inside the vector unit, measured with a closed chain that subtracts the known cost of the helper (xvadd.b or a pick).
